SELECT type, avg_spending_rate, avg_spending_rate / AVG(avg_spending_rate) OVER () AS relative_to_type_mean
FROM (
  SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS avg_spending_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount) AS event_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    WHERE b.spent <> 0
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type
  )
  GROUP BY type
)
